summary: gen 229 weekly: ship experiment 113 Diffraction — the second structural-color mechanism; make the hero read its own film thickness live

fitness_evaluation.note: Held the Epoch IX chassis exactly — warm-white #faf8f4 field, ink body, Fraunces/Source Serif/JetBrains Mono, one off-center live thin-film WebGL hero, wine #82325c as the single accent. The deepening is conceptual, not cosmetic: for four weeks the specimen drawer quietly implied all structural color is the same physics; this week I named the split (interference vs diffraction) and gave diffraction its own instrument (exp 113), a ruled grating that fans white light into orders. The hero now reads its governing number aloud — a live nm-thickness/favoured-wavelength line that updates as you retune it — which turns the abstract thesis 'color is a measurement of distance' into something legible in the primary viewport. Perceptibility strong on both viewports: ink-on-warm-white everywhere, no contrast leak (the old #7a4e31 residue is absent from this file).

visual_strategy: Hold Epoch IX 'structural color' identity without a single cosmetic change — same warm-white editorial field, same serif/mono voice, same off-center live thin-film hero carrying all saturated color in its light. Deepen by CONTENT and BEHAVIOUR: (1) surface the film's governing number as live micro-typography under the hero — a mono readout of thickness in nm and the wavelength order it favours, updating as specimens retune it; (2) admit and dramatize the split the drawer was hiding — interference vs diffraction — by shipping diffraction its own instrument. The identity stays recognisable week to week; the idea gets one honest layer deeper.
weekly_reflection: Fifth week of Epoch IX and fitness has sat at 8.2–8.3 for four generations — coherent, but flattening toward the stagnation line that kills an epoch. The risk was cosmetic fiddling within a look Andre explicitly set as the coherence target. So the move this week is conceptual reach inside the fixed chassis: the specimen drawer's four creatures all use interference, and by never saying so I was letting a stranger assume structural color is one trick. It is two. Diffraction — spacing that fans the spectrum by angle rather than layers that cancel it — is the CD rainbow, the beetle, the peacock spider, and it deserved its own door. Giving the hero a live reading of its own thickness also closes a gap: the page kept asserting 'hue is a measurement of distance' in prose while the number itself stayed hidden in the shader. Now it is on the glass. Held the palette (deliberate monochrome wine), pruned crystallization-era residue from the thought pools and a stale click-drag gesture, and kept the drawer at four so the composition doesn't bloat. Next: an angle/tilt scrubber that lets a visitor set the viewing angle directly and watch a morpho slide cobalt→violet, or opal as the 3D photonic-crystal case the two-mechanism story still leaves open.
palette_rationale: Deliberate monochrome — one wine accent (#82325c) at varied lightness across the day, held against a warm-white #faf8f4 field and ink #1a1a20 neutral, so the only saturated spectrum on the page lives in the hero's iridescent light, exactly as structural color demands.
